title: Entity growth batch 04 — group C
notes: Breadth-first candidate group for Issue #203. Sollet and Slope were rejected from the initial pool because current first-party lifecycle boundaries were insufficient; Cake Wallet and OneKey replace them. Canonical publication prohibited until validation and manual review complete.

entities.summary: Non-custodial Solana wallet ecosystem distributed as browser extensions and mobile applications.
entities.notes: Current first-party Glow developer documentation explicitly calls Glow non-custodial and separates extension, iOS and Android surfaces. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

entities.summary: Open-source non-custodial multichain wallet founded as a Monero wallet and expanded to additional cryptocurrency networks and platforms.
entities.notes: Cake Wallet first-party history says the project was founded in 2018 and started as the first Monero wallet for iOS, with open-source self-custody. Year precision only.

entities.summary: Wallet ecosystem from OneKey spanning a standalone software wallet application and integration with OneKey hardware wallets.
entities.notes: OneKey first-party material states OneKey App can operate as a standalone software wallet or with OneKey hardware. Current keyless architecture also states no single party including OneKey can reconstruct the complete key. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

entities.summary: Blockstream self-custody Bitcoin and Liquid software-wallet lineage, currently branded Blockstream App and formerly branded Blockstream Green and GreenAddress.
entities.notes: First-party Blockstream history preserves GreenAddress -> Blockstream Green -> current Blockstream App continuity. The 2019 Green rebrand/rebuild is not treated as the initial entity launch date because the predecessor wallet predates it.

entities.summary: Non-custodial Bitcoin and Layer 2 mobile wallet operated by JAN3, supporting Bitcoin, Liquid, Lightning-related flows and USDt integrations.
entities.notes: AQUA first-party terms identify JAN3 LLC and describe AQUA as non-custodial. It is modeled separately from Blockstream Jade and the Blockstream Green/App lineage. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

products.notes: Selected browser-extension runtime only; iOS and Android products are deferred.

products.summary: Open-source non-custodial Cake Wallet application distributed across mobile and desktop operating systems.
products.notes: First-party history establishes the Cake Wallet lineage in 2018. Current first-party distribution presents the same wallet application across supported platforms.

products.summary: OneKey mobile software wallet application that can operate standalone or alongside OneKey hardware wallets.
products.notes: Selected mobile software runtime only. Desktop, extension, web and hardware-wallet products are deferred.

products.summary: Current Blockstream mobile software wallet, formerly branded Blockstream Green.
products.notes: Continuity from Green/GreenAddress is preserved. The 2019 Green mobile release/rebrand does not establish the original lineage launch.

products.summary: AQUA non-custodial mobile Bitcoin and Layer 2 wallet application.
products.notes: Current first-party distribution lists App Store, Google Play and direct Android APK.

evidence.notes: Current official distribution page lists Glow desktop browser extensions separately from mobile applications.

evidence.title: About Us | Cake Wallet
evidence.notes: First-party history states Cake Wallet was founded in 2018, began as the first Monero wallet for iOS, and was built around open-source self-custody.

evidence.title: Cake Wallet: Payments Made Easy
evidence.notes: Current first-party page describes Cake Wallet as open-source and non-custodial and lists current mobile/desktop downloads.

evidence.title: How Keyless Wallet Works in OneKey
evidence.notes: First-party OneKey architecture states its Keyless Wallet is true self-custody and no single party, including OneKey, can reconstruct the complete key.

evidence.title: Quick Start: OneKey App
evidence.notes: Current first-party guide states OneKey App includes desktop, mobile and extension versions and can be used standalone or with OneKey hardware.

evidence.title: The All-New Blockstream Green Wallet
evidence.notes: First-party Blockstream history explicitly rebrands GreenAddress to Blockstream Green and preserves the existing wallet lineage rather than establishing a brand-new entity.

evidence.title: Blockstream App
evidence.notes: Current Blockstream site explicitly states Green is now the Blockstream app and identifies it as the current Bitcoin/Liquid wallet.

evidence.notes: First-party terms identify JAN3 LLC and describe AQUA as a non-custodial Bitcoin and Layer 2 wallet.
